name: The Ectoplasmic Distiller

meta.previous: A Supernatural Device (Alliance), A Supernatural Device (Horde)

summary: In Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler lacks the funds and help to finish his extra-dimensional ghost revealer. He asks you for costly materials and forty gold to build its first piece, an ectoplasmic distiller.

sections.title: What Mux Needs
sections.body:
Mux Manascrambler welcomes your help with his ghost revealer, a machine meant to reach across dimensions. First, he needs a distiller to gather the fabric of death itself. Building it will be difficult. Mux asks for one delicate arcanite converter, four greater eternal essences, ten stonescale oil, twenty-five volcanic ash, and forty gold.

The volcanic ash must come from the lava pools of the Burning Steppes. It will make the distiller's filter. The materials are costly, but Mux says he needs every one.

sections.title: Mux's Thanks
sections.body: Mux says you brought exactly the materials he needed, just in time. He promises the distiller will be ready in moments, and gives you something for your trouble.

faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan, Tanaris, asks for materials while building an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.
Mux needs one delicate arcanite converter, four greater eternal essences, ten stonescale oil, twenty-five volcanic ash, and forty gold.

faq.q: Where is the volcanic ash found?
faq.answer: Mux says to gather volcanic ash from the lava pools of the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Why does Mux need these specific components?
faq.answer: The materials go into an ectoplasmic distiller, which gathers the stuff death is made of. The volcanic ash makes its filter.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the materials?
